ValidationRule.description: Cannot process Event Status on certain Sign Off Status
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( TEXT(Approval_Required__c) = 'Approval Required', ISCHANGED(Event_Status__c), OR(TEXT(Sign_Off_Status__c) = 'Proposed', TEXT(Sign_Off_Status__c) = 'Declined', ISBLANK(TEXT(Sign_Off_Status__c))), AND(NOT(TEXT(Event_Status__c) = 'Cancelled'), NOT(TEXT(Event_Status__c) = 'Planning')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If approval is required than ‘Sign Off Status’ must be ‘Approved’ in order to move to any other status except Cancelled
